title: 3-Day Express Gorilla and Chimpanzee Tour
summary: A 3-day Uganda Express Gorilla and Chimpanzee safari is possible by flying into Kigali, Rwanda, and heading to Bwindi Impenetrable National Park in Uganda for gorilla trekking and Kalinzu Forest for chimpanzee trekking.
description: A 3-day Uganda Express Gorilla and Chimpanzee safari is possible by flying into Kigali, Rwanda, and heading to Bwindi Impenetrable National Park in Uganda for gorilla trekking and Kalinzu Forest for chimpanzee trekking. This itinerary minimizes travel time, allowing you to complete both primate treks within three days.
start_flexibility: Can start any day.

itinerary.title: Pick up from Kigali and Transfer to Kibale National Park
itinerary.description: You will be picked up from your hotel or from Kigali International Airport (KGL) and embark on a journey to Kibale National Park, having lunch en route. Kibale is home to the largest number of chimpanzees in East Africa. Upon arrival, you'll check in at the lodge for dinner and an overnight stay at the lodge.
itinerary.accommodation: Guereza Canopy Lodge - Mid-range lodge bordering Kibale NP without fences

itinerary.title: Chimp Trekking in Kibale National Park and Transfer to Bwindi Impenetrable National Park
itinerary.description: After an early breakfast, you will drive to the visitor center for a briefing before the chimpanzee tracking. The trek is typically shorter and less strenuous than the gorilla trek, taking a few hours in the forests. You get an hour with the chimpanzees once found. After the activity, you'll have lunch. Then, your guide will drive you to Bwindi Impenetrable National Park for dinner and an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Bweza Gorilla Lodge - Mid-range lodge just outside Bwindi Impenetrable NP

itinerary.title: Gorilla Tracking in Bwindi and Transfer to Kigali
itinerary.description: You will have an early breakfast and transfer to the park headquarters with your packed lunch for a briefing by the guides. You will embark on the gorilla trekking adventure, which can take 2 to 7 hours depending on the gorillas' movement. You will spend one hour observing the gorilla family once located. Your driver guide will drive you to Kigali for drop-off at your hotel or Kigali International Airport for your departure flight.

title: 12-Day Uganda Safari with Big Five, Gorillas & Chimps
summary: Set off on a thrilling 12-day Uganda safari packed with adventure and discovery.
description: Set off on a thrilling 12-day Uganda safari packed with adventure and discovery. Track rhinos on foot at Ziwa, cruise beneath Murchison Falls, and trek chimps in Kibale's jungle. Explore Queen Elizabeth for tree-climbing lions, then relax on the serene shores of Lake Bunyonyi. Conquer Bwindi's trails for gorilla trekking, meet golden monkeys in Mgahinga, and conclude with a walking safari through Lake Mburo's scenic landscapes.
start_flexibility: Can start any day.

itinerary.title: Arrival at Entebbe International Airport – Welcome to Uganda
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Entebbe International Airport, you will be warmly welcomed by your professional guide and transferred to your lodge in Entebbe. Spend the remainder of the day at leisure, relaxing and recovering from your international flight.
itinerary.accommodation: Entebbe Palm Hotel - Mid-range hotel in Entebbe

itinerary.title: Transfer to Murchison Falls National Park via Ziwa Rhino Sanctuary
itinerary.description: After an early breakfast, depart for Murchison Falls National Park. En route, stop at Ziwa Rhino Sanctuary for a guided walk to track wild rhinos on foot with an armed ranger. Continue to Murchison Falls NP, visiting the Top of the Falls where the Nile squeezes through a narrow gorge before plunging 43 metres below.
itinerary.accommodation: Tilenga Safari Lodge - Mid-range lodge inside Murchison Falls NP

itinerary.title: Morning Game Drive & Afternoon Nile Boat Cruise
itinerary.description: Early morning game drive across the northern sector of Murchison Falls NP searching for elephant, lion, Rothschild's giraffe, buffalo, Uganda kob and more. Afternoon boat cruise on the Nile upstream toward the base of Murchison Falls, passing hippos, crocodiles, elephants and birdlife.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Kibale National Park
itinerary.description: Scenic drive from Murchison Falls to Kibale National Park through rolling landscapes and local villages. Afternoon free to relax at the lodge or interact with the local community, preparing for chimp trekking the next day.
itinerary.accommodation: Bweza Kibale Lodge - Mid-range lodge just outside Kibale NP

itinerary.title: Chimp Trekking & Bigodi Swamp Exploration
itinerary.description: Guided chimpanzee trekking through dense rainforest with experienced rangers, observing chimp behavior, vocalizations and social interactions, plus other primates and birds. Afternoon visit to Bigodi Wetland Sanctuary along elevated boardwalks.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Queen Elizabeth National Park & Evening Game Drive
itinerary.description: Scenic drive through western Uganda past crater lakes and tea plantations to Queen Elizabeth NP. Late afternoon evening game drive across the Kasenyi Plains looking for elephant, buffalo, Uganda kob, and possibly lion.
itinerary.accommodation: The Bush Lodge - Mid-range lodge just outside Queen Elizabeth NP

itinerary.title: Morning Game Drive & Kazinga Channel Boat Cruise
itinerary.description: Morning game drive on the Kasenyi Plains. Afternoon boat cruise along the Kazinga Channel linking Lake Edward and Lake George, known for dense hippo and crocodile concentrations plus abundant birdlife.

itinerary.title: Ishasha Game Drive & Transfer to Bwindi Impenetrable National Park
itinerary.description: Game drive through the Ishasha Sector famous for tree-climbing lions, then continue on to Bwindi Impenetrable NP through rolling hills and villages, arriving in the afternoon to prepare for gorilla trekking.
itinerary.accommodation: Bweza Gorilla Lodge - Mid-range lodge just outside Bwindi Impenetrable NP

itinerary.title: Gorilla Trekking in Bwindi Impenetrable National Park
itinerary.description: Briefing by Uganda Wildlife Authority rangers before a mountain gorilla trekking hike through dense rainforest. Once a habituated gorilla family is found, spend a magical hour observing them feed, play and interact. Receive a gorilla trekking certificate afterward.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Mgahinga Gorilla National Park & Nature Walk
itinerary.description: Scenic drive to Mgahinga Gorilla NP beneath the Virunga Volcanoes. Afternoon guided nature walk through forests, bamboo zones and montane vegetation, spotting birds and butterflies.
itinerary.accommodation: Ichumbi Hotel - Kisoro - Mid-range hotel less than 1hr from Mgahinga Gorilla NP

itinerary.title: Transfer to Lake Mburo National Park & Evening Game Drive
itinerary.description: Drive through southwestern Uganda to Lake Mburo NP. Evening game drive searching for zebra, giraffe, impala, eland, buffalo, topi and waterbuck as animals become more active in the cooler hours.
itinerary.accommodation: Hyena Hill Lodge - Budget lodge just outside Lake Mburo NP

itinerary.title: Walking Safari, Equator Stop & Transfer to Kampala
itinerary.description: Guided walking safari in Lake Mburo NP with an armed ranger, spotting zebra, giraffe, impala and topi on foot. Drive back to Kampala, stopping at the Uganda Equator for photos and the water experiment, with an optional Ankole cultural experience en route. Arrive Kampala/Entebbe for drop-off.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara National Reserve

Full-day game drives exploring endless plains habitat containing more than 2 million large animals. Optional Oldupai Gorge visit and hot air balloon flight available. Accommodation and meals provided.

itinerary.title: Serengeti to Ngorongoro Conservation Area

itinerary.description: Travel to UNESCO World Heritage Site Ngorongoro Crater, an ancient volcanic caldera teeming with life. itinerary.title: Karatu - Central Serengeti National Park
itinerary.description: Travel to Central Serengeti for daytime wildlife observation with lunch at a scenic park location. itinerary.destination: Central Serengeti - Northern Serengeti National Park
itinerary.title: Central Serengeti - Northern Serengeti National Park

Crocodile-filled river crossing creates dramatic spectacle. Stay at Sero Tented Camp; all meals and water provided.

itinerary.destination: Northern Serengeti - Central Serengeti National Park
itinerary.title: Northern Serengeti - Central Serengeti National Park
itinerary.description: Morning game drive continues observation of migration patterns. Afternoon return to Central Serengeti for overnight stay at Serengeti Classic View Camp with complete meal service and water access.

itinerary.title: Central Serengeti - Ngorongoro Crater
itinerary.description: Travel to Ngorongoro for crater game drive with packed lunch. The crater hosts around 30,000 large mammals year-round, including buffalo, lions, elephants, cheetahs, and the rare black rhino. Birdlife includes flamingos, eagles, and buzzards. Farm of Dreams Lodge accommodations; all meals and water included.

itinerary.title: Karatu - Arusha - Zanzibar Island
itinerary.description: Relaxation at lodge with optional Karatu shopping tour. Afternoon transfer to Arusha Airport for Zanzibar flight. Upon arrival, private transfer to Stone Town hotel (Tembo Hotel). Breakfast and dinner included; lunch and beverages excluded.

itinerary.title: Zanzibar Stone Town
itinerary.description: Guided Stone Town exploration featuring narrow streets lined with many residential houses that preserve their original Swahili-Omani themes with exquisitely carved doorways, metal studs, overhanging balconies, and latticed windows. Visitors observe colonial churches and historic mosques. Transfer to beach hotel (Villa Kiva Hotel); breakfast and dinner included.

itinerary.title: Zanzibar Island
itinerary.description: Dedicated beach relaxation day. Zanzibar's beaches are celebrated for their pristine white sands and crystal-clear turquoise waters, often framed by swaying palm trees. Villa Kiva Hotel accommodations; breakfast and dinner provided.

itinerary.title: Zanzibar Island
itinerary.description: Beach relaxation continues. The archipelago consists of many small islands and two large ones, Unguja (the main island, informally referred to as Zanzibar) and Pemba Island. Villa Kiva Hotel stay; breakfast and dinner included.

itinerary.title: Zanzibar Island
itinerary.description: Further beach relaxation exploring the magic of the Spice Island, a captivating archipelago off the coast of Tanzania, renowned for its pristine beaches, vibrant culture, and rich historical heritage. Villa Kiva Hotel accommodations; meals and water as on previous days.

itinerary.title: Zanzibar Island
itinerary.description: Final beach day featuring relaxation. Zanzibar, with its white sand beaches lined with swaying palm trees and gently caressed by the crystal-clear waters of the Indian Ocean, is the epitome of a tropical paradise. Villa Kiva Hotel; breakfast and dinner provided.

itinerary.title: Hotel - Zanzibar Airport
itinerary.description: After breakfast, transfer to Zanzibar Airport concludes the safari experience. Breakfast included; lunch and dinner not provided.

Accommodation: Ngorongoro Serena Safari Lodge. All meals and drinking water included.

itinerary.title: Karatu to Arusha

The journey begins in Kigali, where guests stay at the luxurious Hotel des Mille Collines with dinner included. Days two and three center around Tiloreza Volcanoes Ecolodge, positioned less than an hour from the national park, with all meals provided throughout. Transportation utilizes open-sided 4x4 vehicles, and airport transfers are included. The operator can arrange international flights and pre/post-tour accommodations for additional fees.
start_flexibility: Can start any day (subject to availability).

itinerary.title: Arrival: Kigali
itinerary.description: Travelers are collected from Kigali airport and transferred to Hotel des Mille Collines for check-in. Guests have the opportunity for formal introductions and to run over the exciting program for the upcoming Rwanda tour. Dinner is provided; overnight accommodation included.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kigali
itinerary.description: After breakfast, a guided city tour visits the Kigali Genocide Memorial, Rwanda Art Museum, and Niyo Art Gallery. The Kigali Genocide Memorial is a powerful and poignant site dedicated to honoring the memory of the victims. Lunch follows at Heaven Restaurant. Guests then drive to Volcanoes National Park, arriving at Tiloreza Volcanoes Ecolodge in the evening. All meals and non-alcoholic drinks included.

itinerary.title: Gorilla Trekking & Departure
itinerary.description: An early 6:00 AM breakfast precedes the 7:00 AM park briefing. The guided trek begins at 8:00 AM in the Virunga Mountains, which encompass six active and three extinct volcanoes. After trekking, guests return to the lodge for lunch, then depart for Kigali International Airport. Breakfast and lunch provided; dinner not included.

itinerary.title: Kigali to Nyungwe National Park - Canopy Walk Experience

itinerary.destination: Game Drive in Akagera National Park

itinerary.description: Departure at 4:00 a.m., three-hour drive to park entrance. Eight-hour game drive beginning at 7:00 a.m. covering south to north sections. Evening four-hour drive to Muhabura Hotel in Musanze. All meals and non-alcoholic drinks provided.

Overnight at Hotel Muhabura. All meals and non-alcoholic beverages included.
